meta.title: SCRIPE-Frontend Multi-Role RBAC, Dotted FLS & Session Sync Architecture

views.label: 1. RouteGuard & SuperAdmin Split
views.note: Separates isPlatformSuperAdminUser (!user?.tenantId) from isTenantSuperAdminUser and enforces PAGE_PERMISSIONS fail-closed.

views.label: 2. Tenant Pickers & Dotted FLS Studio
views.note: Catalog separates system vs tenant caches and drops platformOnly while Roles & UserGroups keep dotted keys like crm.opportunities.

views.label: 3. Session Sync & Partial CRM FLS
views.note: RBAC and entitlement edits resync Zustand principals (overwriting []) while CRM update/close omit undefined restricted fields.

boundaries.label: Core Client Authz, Sync & Store Isolation Layer

components.label: RouteGuard Boundary
components.explanation: Evaluates normalized route paths against PAGE_PERMISSIONS and synchronized menu trees before rendering protected views.

components.label: PAGE_PERMISSIONS Map
components.explanation: Synchronizes all 490 catalog codes, separates isPlatformSuperAdminUser (!user?.tenantId) from isTenantSuperAdminUser, and removes platform locks on /audit, /security, and /entitlements/payouts.

components.label: PermissionProvider
components.explanation: Replaces loose substring role matching with explicit backend flags and exposes canAccessPage and superadmin booleans cleanly.

components.label: usePermission Hooks
components.explanation: Restricts unconditional superadmin bypass strictly to platform sessions (!user?.tenantId) while enforcing effective permissions on tenant admins.

components.label: Zustand Auth Store
components.explanation: Holds current effective permissions, roles ordered by priority, and lowercased FLS restrictedFields map in memory.

components.label: Authz Cache Sync
components.explanation: Refreshes /auth/admin/principal, overwrites permissions/roles even when empty [], wipes store and TanStack caches on 401/403, and invalidates navigation and catalog keys.

components.label: Session Sync Bridge
components.explanation: Exposes useSessionAuthorizationSync across UserGroups, Overrides, Subscriptions, and Editions ViewModels via getAuthRepository without cross-module imports.

components.label: Permission Catalog Hook
components.explanation: Separates system vs tenant TanStack queryKeys and filters out platformOnly items across all tenant permission pickers.

components.label: FLS Field Guard Hook
components.explanation: Normalizes resource keys to lowercase and matches restricted DTO fields case-insensitively across CRUD tables and forms.

components.label: Roles & Matrix Studio
components.explanation: Preserves dotted resources in PermissionConfigDialog, hides all_tenants in BulkScopeMenu for tenant roles, locks T_SCRIPE_SA, and sorts roles by priority ascending.

components.label: UserGroups Restrictions
components.explanation: Uses immutable draft cloning, per-row React useId datalists, additive union alerts, truthful required-field error copy, and has-gated picker branching.

components.label: CRM Partial Payload Svc
components.explanation: Omits undefined restricted fields (currencyCode, dealKind, estimatedAmount) on updateOpportunity and closeOpportunity so server FLS preserves DB state cleanly.

cards.title: Eliminated Privilege Escalation
items: Removed roleName.includes('super') and username === 'superadmin' tenant bypasses
applyRefreshedPrincipal overwrites permissions/roles cleanly even on empty [] responses
401 and 403 revocation errors wipe Zustand state, navigation store, and TanStack Query cache

cards.title: Dotted FLS & Partial Payloads
items: Roles and UserGroups editors extract full dotted resources like crm.opportunities
SetRestrictionsDialog clones drafts immutably with unique per-row useId() datalists
